acceptance: On a 404 or 410 for a page, verify fetches the root of that page's origin once per run (https, the page's host and effective port, path /, no userinfo, query or fragment; same allow-list, redirect and size rules; cached per origin for the run); a root that is not 200 or fails to fetch makes the source `blocked` (the host refuses verify's requests), a root of 200 keeps `not-found`
Other statuses map as today (401, 403, 429 blocked; other non-200 not-found); a 200 page makes no extra request
